content: Paulus la nkar lia Makedonia me Yunani

La'pa kokokna-rariarin lawna la Epsus namtierun wa, noma Paulus nawoka-nale'ga makpesiay Yesus pa nala lira nnio'a-niat lia re pa nhi' aruria ir ralamni, nhor diemade nakot tar lia re dewade la' pa nodi liarni pa nla'awa Makedonia.
Nalala' pa ntomra-nnah'a la'a makden Makedonia liewnu pa nano'a-na'atga liawanni la makpesiay Yesusa, totpena yana rwadur la pesiayni. Nhorwua noma nodi liarni la Yunani.
Ndella Yunani pia nalo'on nana wolla wotelu. La'pa niwa nhopal la Siria, noma natlin nana makden Yahudi riwa rla' lir id pa rwen e'a. La' hade pede e netlia hota nawali pia la nlola Makedonia.

Sopater, Pirus a'nani mak kden la Berea la'pa ror rewre'wa Paulus talla. Emkade walia Aristarkus nora Sekundus riy mak kden la Tesalonika, me Gayus makden Derbe, Timotius, Tikhikus me Trofimus riy mak kden la Asia yapatni.
Irala' ulga am pia rwei lia' Troas.
La la'pa lerlalawna roti mak edonna rnairia tgo'a nhorwua, noma amhopal pa mto'or doinia Pilipi. Tre' ma'ta lera wolim pa amawok owa'an la Troas. Amparin tiar lia Troas krei id ralamni.
Paulus la ntomra-nnah'a la makden Troas la' ler hohoni
Krei lerni pa nmel wa, noma amawok pa ama'an rewre'wa emeka riy nora hyalli.
Paulus nora rwahaur wutu, yoma hota repar de eniwa nla'awa. Paulus naltier niande la'pa mela letargara.
La' kamri gen nio' heyanna, nniawok gen miamni de, leler momuou lia' wa'du.

Tuwari ida nanni Etikhus namtatna la'a folla. Yoma Paulus wniahaurnu plahwa, noma tuwari die nhoki ntemna pa nanin tar muemna la folla nhi'noka ntuin pa nalla yawa. La rom tutul die dadanni wotelu. La'pa rmai pia irrana, de nmati olekwa.
Mere Paulus nerun pa nakowa la tuwari die na'nama nkorreria. Na'nama Paulus niwra: “Ee, yan mimta'ata, e nmormior owa'ana.”
Nhor nioma Paulus nha'at owa'an la heyanan pa nhakra roti pia ira'an rewre'wa.
Nwahaur pa nodi liarni la repardoin yawyawra, noma Paulus nla'awa.
Riy rla rottiaru tuwar diella romni yoma nmormior mia'ta, ne ralamni re rahepuepur memna.
Paulus ndella Troas pa nla'awa Miletus
Noma amha'at la kapli totpena amhopal pa mala' ulga Paulus la leta Asos. Mere Paulus nwaror oleka yala'ani onni, de e nlol keranni. La Asos nanpena Paulus hota nha'at la kapli pa nor rewre'wa ami.
La'pa ampatrom la Asos, noma amora Paulus mha'at la kapli pa amora mhopal pa mla'awa leta Metilene.
Amden la hande pa repar wa, dewade amhopal pa amte'ela' gen miaka kapal reria noha Khios. La'pa walin de amte'ela Samos. Lera id owa'an de amte'ela Miletus.
Paulus nano'a-na'atga makpesiay o'tani-matni
Paulus neti olek la, hota edonna nlola Epsus totpena yana nahe'i miamain la'a geni-tien mak kden la Asia. Nmahrur niohor totpena pleta-plet pa nla Yerusalem pa nlernana lerlalawna Pentakosta.
Hade pede Paulus nden la Miletus (pa niwa nala nnio'a la makden Epsus), pede nwaka o'ta-mata la' makpesiay Yesus pa rma rwatrom e'a.
La'pa rmai wia dewade Paulus nakot la re: “Am miy re, mimiatga emkameni la amuormior di, la' lera yanulu maka atie'ela Asia la'pa ntutu-nte'ela ler maka awuaran wa.
A'ului-unuhru nohora a nhiu'ru-a nhielmu, pa akar lia Itmatromni kniarni. Alier la yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani la'a Yahudi wniaror yatyatni mai a'u.
Mimiatga de a'g edonna umta'ata ukota la' miy, la'a hya' mak kodia unut tiy miy. Awuatutu-wuaye' tiy miy lia'a yawoka-yale'u lalawna gaini, me la'a roma-lewu.

La'pa Yahudi miy, la'pa Yahudi atia'a nhi'inde a'ukot mamain tiy miy, totpena mhioitio'ora-mtiahnei dioinia do'omi-halmi totpa mlier la Uplerlawna limni ralamni, me mpiesiaya Itmatromni Yesus Kristus.
Dodo'ondi aliernohora Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli pa alia'awa la Yerusalem, me a'uplinga hota hya' maka aliernana la hande.
Agat tio'a de, la'a leta-leta re de Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli Nakot targ a' pua hota alia'a roma nhio'la, me hota alier la kropna-krieutu.

Mere a'g edonna wuadan nohora a mormio'ru di, hornama akari ahorga kniar miaka Itmatromni Yesus Nal pa akaria ne, adien rer lia kniari pa la'pa la'awa a mormio'ru hohoni pa ukot nohora Uplerlawna Kot Kalwiedni-Paitiotni de mak kakot nohora Uplerlawna Nhi' samomuou lia rimormiori.

Atiomra-niah' oleka ina-nara ama-hyali hononmi, me a'ukot nohor oleka emkameni la Uplerlawna Nodi plolli emolmolla Ray ida. Dodo'ondi de, a'g edonna ghe'du nan miy wia, wniatroma-tniahnei edonan mai it wa.

La' hade pede a'ukota ploloi-plele'era la' miy lia ler di, la'pa miy edon mliernohor a lira-nnio'u pa hota la' ler ida mlier la yatyatni-halalli pa rrinnia miy lia ai mormiori ralamni, de orgahami to'a.
Yoma a'g edonna uwlar tiar lia a knia'ru maka a'ukot nohora tiy miy Uplerlawna ralma-riorni honona mak Enhopan pa awuahaur nohora.

Am miy re, yanin edonna-yamat edonna la' miy. Ne emolmolla riy mak katiaka nhi'inde natiak reria dumni, hota miy die mpialia riy mak katiaka riy makpesiay Yesus. Hade pede mitiak makpesiay Yesus honona, maka Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli Nal oleka la' miy pia mitiaka. Makpesiay ri, Uplerlawna Nala Wutmueha-Laimieha pa la'pa rtowr riarni, me Nler la matmiati-molmuolu ralamni totpena rla' E gahani.
Awuaran kuku' la handi, de hota riy rmai tieman tiy miy. Ne emolmolla ahpuora-ahdiawra rlihir matmata-rhaw riarara, ri'a re hota rhi'a yatyat la makpesiay re.
Ntawua krei mutnu ralamni nekane, riy wo'ir mana hota rakot nohora kot mak kodia lir kdiori. Ir rhi' emkade, totpena riy makpesiay Yesus rler la klieratni, me rlernohor re.
La hade pede yan mininmi la yatiaka. Mpiahniorta. La'a anni wotelu die ului-unuhru. Lera nhaur mela, edon rien a lia nnio'a-niat tiy miy hononmi. Emkade wal lia hota mitiaka riy makpesiay.

Am miy re, dodo'ondi de agotil miy lia Uplerlawna, totpena E' ed mak kwilla-kmata miy. Ne totpena mkiol pitpit lia E nehlani totpa yana mhiortaplinga mliernohora E Kot Kalwiedni-Paitiotni mak Nakot nohora oleka tiy miy wia, de emkameni Nhi' samomuou mai ita. Uplerlawna ed mak kodi plolli pa Nhi' aruri miy, ne hota mdiunit nana-mpietur nana ra'ani-pallu mak Enken tiarga la'a riy mak E Nhi' la E kamieheni.
Am miy re, la'a mormio'ru ralamni atiutg oleka talan tiy miy. Net niana-npat niana a wniaro'ru pa miala kupna-kai, hewewta-naniairi mai a'u.
Ne mimieh'a miatga de, ndella a ruri-lai wamueh'u, pa akar (ha ulti pa ghi'a larma) pa agala utu'tu agora a mutwua'lu mak klernohora a'u ya'an mamni-yemun mamni, hewewat mamni-naniair mamni.

La'a hihi'u-yapya'pu honona de, agal oleka talan tiy miy, de la'a kniar werwerta emkade de tkar pia tatwaran nana riy mak edonna ktaru me riy mak kakleha ruri. Ne yana tsoratdoini hya' maka Itmatromni Yesus Nmeh'a Nakot targ oleka wa, Niwra: “Italla riy, hota itlernana Uplerlawna ra'ani-pallu liawanni. Mere la'pa twei pia riy ral mai ita de itlernan to'a Uplerlawna ra'ani-pallu oke' nmeh'a.” Mitlina oleka me mhioratreria it kalwiedni.”
La'pa Paulus nwahaur pa nhorwua, dewade ir honona rewre'wa pa rwaltiora-rwaltieman pa rsumbaini.
Ir honona rko'a-rkakru me rhedge'du memna, me rkorreria Paulus pa rkinnia yoma niwa nla'awa.
Mak kwarini honona ralamni rmawal doin la, yoma Paulus niwra: “Hota miy edonna mimkek olek a wua.” Noma rlidan nohora pa rottiarga la kapli.
